description: Example, not yet run: Doppler's own Node/Dawn pipeline for one package and model on amd-host, whole model in one pipeline. Copy this file, set the ${...} variables, and keep one id per package-independent target so runs of different packages compare against each other.

remoteNotes.host: An SSH alias resolved by the operator's own SSH configuration, or 'local'. No address is stored here.
remoteNotes.packageRoot: An installed Doppler package directory on the host with its dependencies (node_modules), including the Node WebGPU provider.
remoteNotes.packageArchive: The archive the package root was installed from; the runner checks every archive file equals the package root's.
remoteNotes.env: Extra environment for the runner on the host, for example DOPPLER_NODE_WEBGPU_MODULE when the default provider is not used.
